title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 201 East Battles Road in Santa Maria, California, as the "Larry Lavagnino Post Office Building".
official_summary: This act designates the facility of the U.S. Postal Service located at 201 East Battles Road in Santa Maria, California, as the Larry Lavagnino Post Office Building.

summary.headline: A federal law renames a Postal Service building in Santa Maria, California, after Larry Lavagnino.
summary.what_it_does: This act officially names the U.S. Postal Service facility at 201 East Battles Road in Santa Maria, California, the Larry Lavagnino Post Office Building. It changes only the building's official name and does not change how mail is handled there. It is a commemorative designation.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on January 4, 2025, and the new name applies from that date.
